definitions.loc: non-blank lines that are not comments; Python docstrings excluded
definitions.cyclomatic: McCabe: 1 + if/elif/for/while/except/with-less; +1 per boolean operand beyond first, ternary, comprehension if, match case, assert
definitions.nesting_depth: max depth of if/for/while/try/with/match blocks in a function
definitions.broad_catch: bare except / except Exception / BaseException (py); '|| true' and '|| :' (sh)
definitions.silent_catch: py handler whose body is only pass/continue/break/return-None/logging calls; sh: '2>/dev/null' count
definitions.dated_comments: comment or docstring lines containing DD.MM.YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD
definitions.churn: git log over full history (repo history starts 2026-05-31 after filter-repo; window < 12 months)
definitions.duplication: normalised 6-line windows (strip, no blank/comment) seen in >=2 places
